posts.en:
dsh-headroom is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-da33adc00f93cc5a0374.html
